title: Implement a generic Set type in Go
description: Implement a generic Set[T comparable] with Add, Remove, Contains, Len, Union, and Intersection.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement Set[T comparable] in set.go using `map[T]struct{}` as backing store:
- `New[T comparable]()`: return &Set[T]{m: make(map[T]struct{})}
- `Add(v)`: s.m[v] = struct{}{}
- `Remove(v)`: delete(s.m, v)
- `Contains(v)`: _, ok := s.m[v]; return ok
- `Len()`: return len(s.m)
- `Union(other)`: copy s into result, add all of other
- `Intersection(other)`: add elements from s that also exist in other
All 5 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
